items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 24 at 8:50AM AKST until November 24 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* WHERE...Annette Island, Ketchikan Gateway Borough, and Prince of
Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...East to northeast winds will shift southeast
during the late morning as the front moves north of the area.
items.areas: Prince of Wales Island; Ketchikan Gateway Borough; Annette Island
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 24 at 6:33AM AKST until November 27 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blowing Snow. Winds gusting as high as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Central and Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Areas of blowing snow could significantly reduce
visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...No additional falling snow is expected. Strong
winds will blow snow already on the ground to create areas of low
visibility near the surface. A brief decrease in winds is expected
Wednesday before winds strengthen once more Thursday.
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Use caution while traveling, especially in open areas.

items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 24 at 4:28AM AKST until November 25 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 40 to 60 mph with gusts up to 75 mph expected.

* WHERE...Shemya and Attu Islands.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 9 AM AKST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are expected between 6 and
8 AM AKST Wednesday morning, with winds decreasing, but remaining
fairly gusty after 9 AM.
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of power outages.

items.headline: Air Quality Alert issued November 23 at 12:14PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
The Department of Environmental Conservation has issued an Air
Quality Alert which is IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 PM AKST TUESDAY.

North Pole has a Stage 2 alert.

Fairbanks has no alert.
